parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic knob located on the upper body of the coffee machine, used for control input.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to adjust settings such as brewing strength or start/stop the machine.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or press inward depending on the design, providing user control input.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: A stainless steel container or bowl that holds coffee grounds or liquid during operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main vessel for mixing or brewing coffee, ensuring heat resistance and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It is detachable and can be removed for cleaning or refilling.

parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: A rotating aluminum component located inside the container, responsible for stirring or mixing.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to mix or blend the coffee or ingredients evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis, driven by an internal motor mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the coffee machine made of ABS plastic, supporting all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the motor, electrical components, and provides stability to the entire machine.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the foundation for all moving parts.
